test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_countmin_distribution_src ( skew_suffix LowCardinality(UInt32), null_reused LowCardinality(Nullable(String)) ) ENGINE = Memory

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_crossover_numeric (value LowCardinality(UInt32) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_crossover_string (value LowCardinality(String) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_retained_numeric (value LowCardinality(UInt32) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0
CREATE TABLE t_countmin_retained_long (value LowCardinality(String) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_distribution_skew_suffix (value LowCardinality(UInt32) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0

CREATE TABLE t_countmin_distribution_null_reused (value LowCardinality(Nullable(String)) STATISTICS(countmin)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_countmin_crossover_src_{dense_reuse} WITH ((number * 104729) % 1048576) % intDiv(1048576, {dense_reuse}) + 1 AS key SELECT toUInt32(key), leftPad(toString(key), 16, '0') FROM numbers(1048576)

INSERT INTO t_countmin_retained_src_{sparse_reuse} WITH if(number < 524288, number + 1, ((((number - 524288) * 104729) % 65536) % intDiv(65536, {sparse_reuse})) * intDiv(524287, greatest(1, intDiv(65536, {sparse_reuse}) - 1)) + 1) AS key SELECT number, toUInt32(key), leftPad(toString(key), 128, '0') FROM numbers(589824) SETTINGS max_block_size = 589824

INSERT INTO t_countmin_distribution_src SELECT toUInt32(if(number < 16384, number + 2, 1)), if(number % 10 < 9, NULL, leftPad(toString(intDiv(number, 10) % 1638), 16, '0')) FROM numbers(65536) SETTINGS max_block_size = 65536
test.query: INSERT INTO t_countmin_crossover_numeric SELECT numeric FROM t_countmin_crossover_src_{dense_reuse}
INSERT INTO t_countmin_crossover_string SELECT string FROM t_countmin_crossover_src_{dense_reuse}
INSERT INTO t_countmin_retained_numeric SELECT numeric FROM t_countmin_retained_src_{sparse_reuse} WHERE id >= 524288
INSERT INTO t_countmin_retained_long SELECT long FROM t_countmin_retained_src_{sparse_reuse} WHERE id >= 524288
INSERT INTO t_countmin_distribution_skew_suffix SELECT skew_suffix FROM t_countmin_distribution_src
INSERT INTO t_countmin_distribution_null_reused SELECT null_reused FROM t_countmin_distribution_src
